record.task: Correct one unambiguous documentation typo without changing behaviour.
record.classificationReason: The change is mechanical, read-only with respect to runtime state, and has an unambiguous expected result.
acceptanceCriteria: No runtime or contract file changes.
record.decisionSummary: The isolated documentation typo was corrected and the surrounding text was unchanged.

record.task: Compact the transfer workspace without changing handlers, API calls, storage, or mount order.
record.classificationReason: This is a source-code and browser-fixture change with reversible presentation mutations and no critical data boundary.
plan: Inspect the live DOM contract and current module IDs.
Apply a late presentation adapter without replacing handlers.
assumptions: Existing element IDs remain the functional handler contract.
The supplied sanitized DOM accurately represents the production shell.
acceptanceCriteria: The modules remain at their existing page locations.
No duplicate panels appear after DOM mutations.
The exact candidate browser suite and aggregate gate pass.

evidence.reference: presentation adapter and sanitized fixture only

verification.check: Exact candidate artifact executes in the transfer fixture.
Negative duplicate and horizontal-overflow assertions pass.

record.decisionSummary: The transfer modules were visually unified through a presentation adapter while their functional contracts remained unchanged.
residualRisks: A future production DOM redesign may require a new fixture and selector adapter.

record.task: Assess whether a fixed userscript artifact is ready for an explicitly approved production deployment.
record.classificationReason: The task crosses release, deployment, production-state, and rollback boundaries.
plan: Identify the exact source commit and artifact digest.
Run deterministic rebuild and exact-artifact checks.
Verify deployment tooling and rollback procedure.
Require explicit operational approval before production mutation.
assumptions: The deployment target and credentials are available only to an authorized operator.
The rollback artifact corresponds to the currently deployed known-good revision.
alternatives: Do not deploy and retain the current production revision.
Deploy to a non-production target for additional smoke testing.
acceptanceCriteria: The artifact digest matches the reviewed candidate.

verification.check: Deployment verifier rejects a mismatched revision.

adversarialVerification.check: Attempt deployment with missing approval and require a blocked result.
Attempt verification against a wrong artifact digest and require failure.

stopConditions: The reviewed artifact digest cannot be matched.
Explicit approval or rollback evidence is absent.

rollback.procedure: Restore the previous known-good artifact and restart the service or client distribution path.
rollback.verification: Confirm the previous revision, health checks, and changed-path smoke test.

approval.authority: repository owner and authorized production operator

record.decisionSummary: The candidate is ready for a separately approved deployment; the quality gate itself does not perform or imply deployment.
residualRisks: Production-only environmental differences remain until post-deploy verification completes.

record.classificationReason: Source code changes require structured execution.

invalidRecords.name: critical record without rollback and approval

record.task: Deploy a new API revision to production.

record.classificationReason: Fixture intentionally violates the privacy boundary.
record.privateReasoning: Internal token-by-token reasoning must not be stored in evidence records.

record.classificationReason: The task changes runtime integration behaviour.
record.decisionSummary: The change succeeded despite a failed check.
